intro.en: Appliance wire and cable connect power, controls, motors, heaters and sensors across different thermal, moisture, movement and service zones inside equipment.
intro.zh: 电器电线电缆连接设备内部的电源、控制器、电机、加热器与传感器，并跨越不同温度、潮气、运动与维修区域。

knowledge.en: Internal wiring, AWM, flexible cord and the completed appliance have different specification and approval boundaries. The exact construction and use conditions must be identified.
knowledge.zh: 内部配线、AWM、柔性软线与完整电器具有不同规范和批准边界，必须明确准确结构与使用条件。

notes.en: Provide the destination market, appliance zone map, circuit loads, temperatures, exposure, movement, wire or cord designation, terminal system and validation plan.
notes.zh: 请提供目标市场、电器分区图、回路负载、温度、环境暴露、运动状态、线材或软线型号、端子系统与验证方案。

delivery.en: Release records the exact wire or cord, conductor and insulation construction, marking, termination, routing, protection, traceability and agreed assembly checks.
delivery.zh: 放行文件记录准确线材或软线、导体与绝缘结构、印字、端接、布线、防护、追溯及约定组件检查。

introduction.en: Map Every Zone Inside the Appliance
introduction.zh: 绘制电器内部每个区域

subtitle.en: Engineer every electrical path for its real zone inside the appliance
subtitle.zh: 根据电器内部真实区域设计每一条电气路径

lead.en: Separate internal wiring from the supply cord, then coordinate heat, moisture, movement, termination and product-level requirements.
lead.zh: 先区分内部配线与电源软线，再协同处理热、潮气、运动、端接与整机层级要求。
